drop.title: Import a PSD and export every layer combination
drop.desc: Pick the layers that form variants → set required / optional / exclusive groups → preview every combination → export them as a single ZIP. Images are composited pixel by pixel the way Photoshop does it.
drop.formats: Supports .psd / .psb from Photoshop, SAI, Procreate, MediBang and .ipv artwork from ibisPaint.
drop.androidHint: If the PSD is not listed, switch the picker to the Files view or its folder.
drop.desktopHint: You can also drag a .psd / .ipv file onto the window.
